about.statementPre: A real brand at pocket-money prices —
about.narrative: Tall Nest is a Pakistani food & beverage company building its first brand, Jingo — with more in development. Our team brings together seasoned confectionery and FMCG veterans alongside expertise in international trade and modern digital marketing — combining the know-how that moves product off shelves with the reach that builds brands.

flagship.desc: Pakistan's poppiest candy — candies, toffees, lollipops, liquid chocolates, bubblegums, bunties & nimkos.

partners.intro: We don't just sell product — we build relationships. Reliable supply, strong margins, a growing range, and a team that markets the brand alongside you.
